top_signals.title: Hello Kitty Owner Sanrio Axes Japan Show Ties After China Furor
top_signals.summary: Sanrio Co. apologized and scrapped a collaboration with Japanese television drama Vivant after the spy program drew criticism in China over its portrayal of wartime history.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Healey’s Budget spoiled by ‘grim’ living standards squeeze
top_signals.summary: Britain is trapped in a “grim” decade of stagnant living standards, the budget watchdog has said, after John Healey kicked some of the government’s toughest spending decisions on defence and welfare into next year.  The government’s fiscal watchdog said that families are about to see household income drop as a result of the country’s rising [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
